categories.main_business_segments: Super-Dragon Engineering Plastics Co., Ltd specializes in the research, production, and sales of modified plastics, including modified general plastics, modified engineering plastics, and modified special engineering plastics. Their products are widely applied in household appliances, automotive industry, electronics and communications, and medical supplies. Key product series include modified PP, PC/ABS, PA, PBT, and ABS plastics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced polymer modification technologies such as filling modification, reinforcement, flame retardancy, plastic alloying, and functional modification. Production processes include precise formulation, mixing, twin-screw extrusion, cooling, pelletizing, screening, homogenization, and packaging. They have a strong R&D team with patented technologies focusing on high-performance, low-emission, flame-retardant, and environmentally friendly materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are leading enterprises in household appliances (e.g., Midea, Hisense, Supor, Galanz), automotive manufacturers (e.g., Dongfeng, Changan, GAC, Toyota, Chery), and automotive parts suppliers (e.g., Yanfeng, Marelli). The company serves industries including home appliances, automotive, electronics, communications, and medical devices, with products used in components like appliance housings, automotive interiors and exteriors, electronic device casings, and battery modules.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in South China (Guangzhou), East China (Wuhu), and Southwest China (Chongqing). Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 99% of revenue, with growing exports to North America and Southeast Asia. The company is expanding production capacity to better serve regional markets and enhance supply chain responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Super-Dragon operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of modified plastic materials. They procure base resins like PP, PC, ABS, PA, and PBT from upstream petrochemical suppliers and supply high-performance modified plastics downstream to manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in environmental sustainability, functional modification, and high-performance materials aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals and industry upgrades. Key R&D initiatives include developing halogen-free flame retardant materials, high heat-resistant ABS, natural fiber reinforced composites, and materials for emerging sectors like new energy vehicles, robotics, and low-altitude economy. They emphasize innovation in lightweight, eco-friendly, and multifunctional plastics and aim to build integrated 'material-component-system' development platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of modified plastic products to industrial customers. The company also engages in raw material trading as a minor revenue source. Sales are conducted via direct customer engagement, technical support, and customized product development, with a focus on long-term supply contracts and stable customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Super-Dragon is positioned as a leading domestic high-tech enterprise in the modified plastics industry, recognized for its technological innovation, product quality, and comprehensive solutions. It competes with both domestic and international players, including multinational corporations with advanced technologies and strong brands. The company leverages its R&D capabilities, customer base, and regional production footprint to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.71 billion, a 15.74% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.48 million, up 3.57%. It has steadily expanded production capacity with multiple ongoing projects, including new production bases and capacity upgrades. The company maintains a solid financial position with growing assets, equity, and controlled liabilities, supported by successful capital raises including IPO and convertible bonds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Super-Dragon emphasizes high-performance, customized modified plastics that meet stringent requirements for mechanical strength, flame retardancy, low emissions, and environmental sustainability. Their products support lightweighting and functional integration in downstream applications, offering superior quality, stable supply, and technical support. The company’s strong R&D and patent portfolio enable it to deliver innovative solutions tailored to evolving customer needs in emerging industries such as new energy vehicles, electronics, and robotics.
